But they just want estimate. So we need to compute cost. Also maybe need to check credit card balance? Not specified. They want estimated total payable amount. So we can compute cost and maybe add insurance? Not asked. So just cost.

We need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide estimate.

We might need to authenticate? The get_flight_cost doesn't require auth. So we can call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then respond.

Let's do that.
